_meta.task: #138 — layer 4: query rewriting (symptom -> solution-language). #135 never touched this layer.
_meta.hypothesis: Corpus documents the FIXED state; agent asks by SYMPTOM. If the mismatch is real, restating the query in the corpus's own resolved/technical voice should raise MRR.
_meta.protocol: Rewrites written by hand BEFORE running, from the QUERY TEXT ONLY. The gold chunk text was NOT consulted while writing a rewrite - otherwise this measures my ability to copy the answer, not the value of rewriting. Author: rag-max.

arms.hyde: HyDE-style: a hypothetical ANSWER passage in the voice our docs use (fix/mechanism statement).
arms.keyword: Decomposition to technical identifiers/subsystem nouns, symptom words dropped.

_meta.honesty_note: This is the weakest link in the study: a human rewrite is an UPPER BOUND, not a shippable system. Production would need a local model to produce these. Read the result as 'is this layer worth automating at all', not as a deployable gain.
